answer_1.quote: We conduct a more comprehensive evaluation spanning 10 unsupervised metrics derived from models' inner representations and predictive distributions to identify word-level translation errors.
answer_1.outputs: machine translation outputs with word-level error span annotations

answer_2.quote: We report Average Precision (AP) as it provides a threshold-independent measure of ranking quality across the full score range.

answer_3.quote: We also test the state-of-the-art supervised WQE model XCOMET in its XL (3.5B) and XXL (10.7B) sizes, using them as binary metrics.

answer_4.quote: DivEMT was created by to evaluate the impact of language typology on MT quality, and how that would influence the productivity of human post-editors working with those systems.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation was conducted using the Error Span Annotation protocol (ESA, ), which has human annotators highlighting erroneous spans in the translation and marking them as either MINOR or MAJOR errors.
